response.title: Kabamanda
paragraphs: Kabamanda is best approached as a hazard-and-switch-pressure team with a flexible three-Pokémon selection, not as a dedicated Sand mode: the supplied roster has no attacker whose ability depends on Sandstorm. Hippowdon can lead with Stealth Rock and use Whirlwind to take advantage of opposing switches. Meowscarada offers Toxic Spikes and fast physical pressure, while Archaludon also carries Stealth Rock if you want to select it instead of one of the other options.

The supplied Mega choices are Salamence Mega and Lucario Mega Z, and they should be treated as alternative selections because no base-form data is supplied for using both in one lineup. A Salamence Mega branch of Hippowdon, Salamence Mega, and Meowscarada trades Lucario Mega Z’s special pressure and Ice resistance for Salamence Mega’s 216 Attack and Dragon Dance setup; Salamence Mega is 4× weak to Ice. The Lucario Mega Z branch of Hippowdon, Lucario Mega Z, and Meowscarada instead brings 216 Special Attack, 223 Speed, and an Ice resistance, but gives up Salamence Mega’s physical setup and Fighting resistance.

Keep the Sandstorm–Focus Sash interaction in mind when using either branch with Meowscarada. Sand Stream does not break Focus Sash at battle start, but if Meowscarada is active at the end of a turn while Sandstorm is still running, the supplied weather effect damages it and can remove the full-HP condition the Sash requires. Hippowdon’s investment is 32 HP and 32 Special Defense, with 2 Defense points; its Impish nature does not mean it is heavily invested in Defense. Meowscarada’s speed and Attack, plus its Sash, make it a useful pressure option, but its timing in Sandstorm matters.

recommendations.title: Choose one Mega branch for each battle and build a complete three-Pokémon selection around it.
recommendations.reason: Use Hippowdon, Salamence Mega, and Meowscarada when Dragon Dance physical pressure and Salamence Mega’s Fighting resistance fit the matchup, while accounting for its 4× Ice weakness. Use Hippowdon, Lucario Mega Z, and Meowscarada when special pressure and an Ice resistance are more useful; this choice gives up Salamence Mega’s physical setup and Fighting resistance. Do not combine the two supplied Mega forms in the same selection without base-form evidence.

recommendations.title: Use Hippowdon’s switch pressure while managing Meowscarada’s Focus Sash around Sandstorm.
recommendations.reason: Hippowdon can establish Stealth Rock and use Whirlwind to exploit switches, while Meowscarada can add Toxic Spikes when appropriate. If Sandstorm is active, avoid leaving Meowscarada on the field through an end-of-turn weather tick when preserving its full-HP Focus Sash matters.
